title: M2 L3 — Day-at-work program (to + verb, Scene 1+2)
readingPassages: Part 1 — Scene 1: Mark and Hana talk about the day-at-work program.
Question: Why did Mark choose his work experience place?
My dream is to be a vet.
Kindergarten (listen): build a tower, draw pictures, play music, read a book
My dream is to be an astronaut. I want to travel to space.
I want to be an interpreter. I want to work with people around the world.
Scene 2 — Ms. Brown and Hana (lunch break):
Ms. Brown: Where do you want to go for your day-at-work program?
Hana: I don't know. I can't decide.
Ms. Brown: Well, think about yourself first. What are your interests?
Hana: Lots of things. Like soccer, movies, cooking....
Ms. Brown: Oh, cooking? What do you like to make?
Hana: I like to bake bread, but I need to practice more.
Ms. Brown: Perhaps a bakery is a good place for you.
